_comment: FM-1 pre-migration snapshot lock for HL-NEW-SAL-CLEAN. Two assertions in schemaFixtureFactory.test.ts: (1) live hand-written HL_NEW_SAL_CLEAN.payload in formPathScenarios.ts deep-equals this snapshot; (2) toScenario(HL_NEW_SAL_CLEAN_JOURNEY).payload deep-equals this snapshot. Both must pass before Step-5 in-place rewrites.
_reconciliation_2026_04_22: Dropped `priorAssessmentHistory: 'first_assessment'` from loanTransaction — the shared `assessmentStatus` flow (caseIntakeQuestions.ts) replaced the per-loan-type question, and a user-verified host walkthrough of /form/home-loan confirms only `assessmentStatus` is surfaced to the DSA. The key was stale legacy data in the hand-written scenario.
_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — hand-written scenario was authored as a desired payload shape, not derived from buildLoanPayload(). Corrected to match current schema + builder output: (1) purchaseType 'Direct Sale' → 'resale_normal' (raw schema option value; 'Direct Sale' was never a valid option); (2) constructionStatus 'Ready to Move' → 'Flat' (builder maps constructionType answer → constructionStatus; V2 schema constructionType options are Flat/House/Floor, not RTM/UC); (3) propertyStage: 'Ready To Move' added (builder maps PropertyStage answer → propertyStage; set via flagKey on propertyLocation page for resale_normal); (4) propertyType: 'Flat' REMOVED (no V2 schema question binds to propertyType key); (5) carpetArea/carpetAreaUnit/carpetAreaRaw added from propertyCharacter page; (6) ocCcAvailable: 'BOTH' added (shown for Flat+RTM on merged complianceLegal page); (7) registryTimeline 'WITHIN_3_MONTHS' → '1_3_MONTHS' (valid option; WITHIN_3_MONTHS was never a schema option value); (8) titleChainStatus/encumbranceCertStatus/successionStatus/revenueRecordMutation REMOVED (all hidden for PLANNED_AUTHORITY — their showWhen requires propertyAreaType in CONVERTED_RESIDENTIAL/OLD_MUNICIPAL/LOCAL_COLONY/UNKNOWN); (9) documentationReadiness ['title_deed','sale_agreement','ec'] → ['SALE_DEED','EC'] (valid PLANNED_AUTHORITY option values); (10) sellerOwnershipType/propertyAcquisitionMethod/sellerOnLoan/lastRegistryDuration/isAnyBuilderDemand added from sellerTransaction_homeLoan page; (11) reraRegistrationStatus REMOVED — q5_reraRegistrationStatus is defined in propertyCondition.ts but excluded from getPropertyConditionQuestions() export, so it is not on any schema page and cannot be set via schema-driven journey steps.
